test.title: Binomial Theorem - Test 5
test.description: Previous Year Questions as Chapter Test
test.syllabus: This test contains questions from all topics of this chapter included in the JEE Main syllabus. It includes a mix of questions from PYQs of JEE Main 2019 - 2025.

question.text: If the co-efficient of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>7</mn></msup></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>8</mn></msup></math> in the expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></mfrac></mrow></mfenced><mi>n</mi></msup></math> are equal, then the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>n</mi></math> is equal to :
The remainder on dividing <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mn>5</mn><mn>99</mn></msup></math> by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>11</mn></math> is _____ .

The coefficient of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>7</mn></msup></math> in <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>-</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup></mrow></mfenced><mn>10</mn></msup></math> is __________ .

If the maximum value of the term independent of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>t</mi></math> in the expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><msup><mi>t</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><msup><mi>x</mi><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>5</mn></mfrac></msup><mo>+</mo><mfrac><msup><mfenced><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>-</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfenced><msup><mrow/><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>10</mn></mfrac></msup></msup><mi>t</mi></mfrac></mrow></mfenced><mn>15</mn></msup><mo>,</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>≥</mo><mn>0</mn></math>, is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>K</mi></math>, then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>8</mn><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">K</mi></math> is equal to _____ .

Remainder when <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mn>64</mn><msup><mn>32</mn><mn>32</mn></msup></msup></math> is divided by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>9</mn></math> is equal to _____.

The coefficient of <math><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msup></math> in the expansion of <math><msup><mrow><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mi>x</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msup></mrow></mfenced></mrow><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow></msup></math> is ________

If the sum of the coefficients in the expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><msup><mo>)</mo><mi>n</mi></msup></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4096</mn><mo>,</mo></math> then the greatest coefficient in the expansion is _____.

The constant term in the expansion of
2x+1x7+3x25 is _____ .
The remainder when $428^{2024}$ is divided by 21 is__________

Let the coefficients of the middle terms in the expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><mfrac><mn>1</mn><msqrt><mn>6</mn></msqrt></mfrac><mo>+</mo><mi>β</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfenced><mn>4</mn></msup><mo>,</mo><msup><mfenced><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>β</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfenced><mn>2</mn></msup></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>-</mo><mfrac><mi>β</mi><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfenced><mn>6</mn></msup><mo>,</mo><mi>β</mi><mo>></mo><mn>0</mn></math>, respectively form the first three terms of an A.P. If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>d</mi></math> is the common difference of this A.P., then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>50</mn><mo>-</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>d</mi></mrow><msup><mi>β</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mfrac></math> is equal to _____ .

If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>(</mo><mn>2021</mn><msup><mo>)</mo><mn>3762</mn></msup></math> is divided by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>17</mn><mo>,</mo></math> then the remainder is _______.

For a positive integer <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>n</mi><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><msup><mfenced><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>x</mi></mfrac></mrow></mfenced><mi>n</mi></msup></math> is expanded in increasing powers of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math>. If three consecutive coefficients in this expansion are in the ratio, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mo>:</mo><mo> </mo><mn>5</mn><mo>:</mo><mo> </mo><mn>12</mn><mo>,</mo></math> then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>n</mi></math> is equal to

If the remainder when <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> is divided by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn></math>, then the remainder when <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><mn>2020</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfenced><mn>2022</mn></msup></math> is divided by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>8</mn></math> is ___ .

Number of integral terms in the expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced close="}" open="{"><mrow><msup><mn>7</mn><mfenced><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mfenced></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mn>11</mn><mfenced><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>6</mn></mfrac></mfenced></msup></mrow></mfenced><mn>824</mn></msup></math> is equal to ______.

<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mn>50</mn><mtext>th </mtext></msup></math> root of a number <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>12</mn></math> and <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mn>50</mn><mtext>th </mtext></msup></math> root of another number <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>y</mi></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>18</mn><mo> </mo></math> . Then the remainder obtained on dividing <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>(</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi><mo>)</mo></math> by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>25</mn></math> is ________.

Let the ratio of the fifth term from the beginning to the fifth term from the end in the binomial expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><mroot><mn>2</mn><mn>4</mn></mroot><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mroot><mn>3</mn><mn>4</mn></mroot></mfrac></mrow></mfenced><mi>n</mi></msup></math>, in the increasing powers of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mroot><mn>3</mn><mn>4</mn></mroot></mfrac></math> be <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mroot><mn>6</mn><mn>4</mn></mroot><mo>:</mo><mn>1</mn></math>. If the sixth term from the beginning is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfrac><mi>α</mi><mroot><mn>3</mn><mn>4</mn></mroot></mfrac></math>, then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>α</mi></math> is equal to _______.

<math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>3</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>7</mn><mn>22</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mn>22</mn></msup><mo>-</mo><mn>44</mn></math> when divided by <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>18</mn></math> leaves the remainder

The number of positive integers <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>k</mi></math> such that the constant term in the binomial expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><mn>2</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mfrac><mn>3</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mi>k</mi></msup></mfrac></mrow></mfenced><mn>12</mn></msup><mo>,</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>≠</mo><mn>0</mn></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mn>2</mn><mn>8</mn></msup><mo>·</mo><mi>l</mi></math>, where <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>l</mi></math> is an odd integer, is ______.

If the constant term in the binomial expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><mfrac><msup><mi>x</mi><mfrac><mn>5</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></msup><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mo>-</mo><mfrac><mn>4</mn><msup><mi>x</mi><mi>l</mi></msup></mfrac></mrow></mfenced><mn>9</mn></msup></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mo>-</mo><mn>84</mn></math> and the coefficient of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>l</mi></mrow></msup></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mn>2</mn><mi>α</mi></msup><mi>β</mi></math> where <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>β</mi><mo><</mo><mn>0</mn></math> is an odd number, then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced close="|" open="|"><mrow><mi>α</mi><mi>l</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>β</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> is equal to _____ .

Let for the <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mn>9</mn><mi>th</mi></msup></math> term in the binomial expansion of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfenced><mi>n</mi></msup></math>, in the increasing powers of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>6</mn><mi>x</mi></math>, to be the greatest for <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>3</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></math>, the least value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>n</mi></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>n</mi><mn>0</mn></msub></math>. If <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>k</mi></math> is the ratio of the coefficient of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>6</mn></msup></math> to the coefficient of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>3</mn></msup></math>, then <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>k</mi><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>n</mi><mn>0</mn></msub></math> is equal to
